SASBDB entry SASDM63  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDM63/)

Publication: Structural basis for specific RNA recognition by the alternative splicing factor RBM5.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-39961-w

The files are the SASBDB downloads, unchanged:
  experimental_data/SASDM63.dat   the curve (q in 1/A; columns q, I, error; short header and trailer)
  SASDM63_fit1.fit                the CRYSOL fit (q in 1/A; columns q, Iexp, Ierr, Icalc)
  SASDM63_fit1_model1.pdb         the atomic model of "fit1": protein chain D (90-307) with one Zn,
                                  RNA chains B and C (12 nt), heavy atoms only
                                  (https://www.sasbdb.org/media/pdb_file/SASDM63_fit1_model1.pdb)

Nothing was cleaned. The paper was not read; the buffer, pH, temperature and X-ray energy
are the SASBDB entry's.

Round 5 rescan (2026-11-13): verdict KEEP, see notes/new-entries/AUDIT5-A.md.
Round 6 (2026-11-13): the paper was read (sources/s41467-023-39961-w.pdf); the zinc of the model
is the RanBP2-type ZnF1 zinc of the construct (Cys187/190/201/204; ZnF1S = C191G stabilised, not
zinc-free). Restored to test/fitting_tests under the owner rule that SASBDB's SAXS buffer stands
when the paper names none.
